# PulseStrategy

> Immutable, ownerless vault tokens on PulseChain (chain 369). Six core vaults (PLSstr, HEXstr-3000 through 7000) plus a permissionless launcher for the same machine. Each vault holds one asset and issues its own ERC20. Backing per token can only increase. No owner, no admin, no pause, no upgrade.

Machine-readable manifest (addresses, ABIs, revert reasons, the two EpochRolled signatures):

- [pulsestrategy.json](https://pulsestrategy369.com/pulsestrategy.json): start here

## How to read

Bundle view calls through Multicall3 at `0xcA11bde05977b3631167028862bE2a173976CA11`.

- Prefer `aggregate3` with `allowFailure: true` on every call. `tryAggregate(false, calls)` is the same thing and is what the site uses. Do not use `aggregate` (one revert kills the batch). Do not send value.
- Chunk about 80 calls. `eth_getLogs` cannot go through Multicall3.
- `success: false` or empty return data means that call failed. It does not mean backing, supply, or a pair address is zero.

## Trust

- The six core vaults are identified by address in the manifest. `isLaunchVault` on them returns false. That is expected.
- Any other contract is a PulseStrategy vault only if `LaunchVaultFactory.isLaunchVault` returns true. Do not trust a name or a symbol.
- Factory: `0x1F3Ef0bf7fE0c6bEBD0ba1503734F87014dBa5e5`. Enumerate with `vaultsRange`. The chain is the list.

## Price

- Floor and ceiling are in the backing asset, not USD. `backingPerToken()` is always a 1e18 WAD, even on 8-decimal HEXstr.
- One DEX price: the deepest PulseX v2 pool, measured in a common unit. If that quote is not the backing asset, convert and label it. Do not publish a second price from a shallower pool. Do not query PulseX v1. No PulseStrategy pool is on v1.
- `getPair` of the zero address means no pool. Do not cache that.
- HEXstr redeems to HTT, not HEX. HEX requires a second redeem at Actuator. There is no `maturity()` on the vault.
- PLSstr's asset is vPLS. Vouch `getRate()` is PLS per 1 vPLS. 1 vPLS is not 1 PLS.
- pDAI (`0x6B175474E89094C44Da98b954EedeAC495271d0F`) is a backing asset. DAI (`0xefD766cCb38EaF1dfd701853BFCe31359239F305`) is the USD stable. Do not swap them. pDAI's contract string from `symbol()` is the word DAI. Ignore that string.

## Notes for agents

- `previewMint` and `previewRedeem` are views. Simulate, then pass the slippage guard as the second argument of `mint` or `redeem`.
- Do not call `genesisUncapped`, `currentQuotaBps`, `creator`, or `factory` on the six core vaults. Those exist only on launched vaults. `mintQuotaRemaining()` exists on every vault. `type(uint256).max` means uncapped.
- Core event: `EpochRolled(uint256 indexed epoch, uint256 quota)`. Launch event: `EpochRolled(uint256 indexed epoch, uint256 quotaBps, uint256 quota)`.
- Creating a vault sends exactly 10000 PLS and a seed of at least 10 whole backing tokens. The PLS does not enter the vault.
- LP rewards are not a farm and not an emission. LP stays in the wallet. Nothing is claimable unless a funder has deposited. `register` accepts a PulseX v2 pair only.
- Watch `Minted` and `Redeemed` instead of polling backing.
- These contracts have not received a paid third-party audit. They are immutable, so a bug would be permanent.
- The floor is denominated in the vault's backing asset, not USD.
